title: Classical Theme
body: Classical themes often mix stepwise motion with dramatic leaps. This one is in G major and spans two octaves — from D4 up to G5. Pay attention to the large jump in bar 3: a sixth.

title: Ascending and Descending
caption: The first two bars climb stepwise: G A B C D B A G. Then bar 3 leaps up to E5 and descends by steps. This alternation between steps and leaps is the classical melodic vocabulary.
